logline: A Seoul fashion photographer whose career collapses returns to her Jeju Island hometown, where the weather forecaster she hurt years ago is the only one waiting.

renewal.note: 16-episode limited run concluded January 21, 2024 on JTBC. The series was written as a standalone story set on Jeju Island with no announced continuation.

bollymeter.basis: The finale hit 12.4% nationwide on Nielsen Korea - an exceptional number for a JTBC weekend drama. South China Morning Post ranked it among the best K-dramas of 2024, and Ji Chang-wook won Top Excellence at the APAN Star Awards.

seasons.review_body: Welcome to Samdal-ri aired December 2023 through January 2024 on JTBC, with Netflix distributing in select international territories. The 16-episode romance follows a disgraced Seoul photographer returning to Jeju Island and rekindling a relationship with a meteorologist whose life was derailed by a tragedy connected to her. The series earned consistently strong viewership, with the finale reaching 12.4% nationwide and 13.1% in Seoul (Nielsen Korea). Ji Chang-wook won Top Excellence Actor at the 2024 APAN Star Awards for his performance. The South China Morning Post included it in its best K-dramas of 2024 rankings. The Jeju setting gave the show a distinctive visual warmth, and critics noted the central pairing's chemistry as the engine that carried the slower-burn early episodes. A comfort watch with genuine emotional investment by the final stretch.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere introduces Sam-dal at her professional lowest - Seoul career in ruins, identity fractured - and sets up her reluctant return to the island she left behind. The Jeju cinematography is immediately distinctive. Yong-pil's emotional wound is established clearly without overplaying the backstory.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Sam-dal arrives on Jeju and sees Yong-pil from a distance - the gap between who they were and who they are now communicated entirely in posture.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 16
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves both the romantic arc and the professional reckoning with a naturalistic sense of earned resolution. The pacing rewards the slow build of the full 16 episodes, and the Jeju setting becomes symbolically loaded in a way the early episodes seeded carefully. The 12.4% final rating confirmed audience investment held to the end.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The reconciliation scene on the coast - quiet, unhurried, and exactly what the series had been building toward.
